## Figure 3.1: Public Debt Disclosures by IDA-Eligible Countries, Accessibility and Coverage, 2020 and 2025
Grouped bar chart

- **Type:** grouped bar chart
- **Time span:** 2020 and 2025
- **Categories on x-axis:**  
  - **Accessibility:** 2020, 2025  
  - **Coverage:** 2020, 2025
- **Y-axis:** numeric scale from **0 to 60** with tick marks at 10-unit intervals
- **Units:** not explicitly stated in the figure; values appear to be index or score levels from the **World Bank Debt Reporting Heat Map**
- **Legend / series:**
  - **All IDA-eligible countries** (dark navy)
  - **Sub-Saharan Africa** (light blue)
  - **Other regions** (orange)

### Values shown by bar height
#### Accessibility
| Year | All IDA-eligible countries | Sub-Saharan Africa | Other regions |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2020 | ≈36 | ≈19 | ≈17 |
| 2025 | ≈54 | ≈29 | ≈25 |

#### Coverage
| Year | All IDA-eligible countries | Sub-Saharan Africa | Other regions |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2020 | ≈33 | ≈18 | ≈15 |
| 2025 | ≈45 | ≈24 | ≈21 |

### Visual comparisons and trends
- **All three groups increase from 2020 to 2025** in both **Accessibility** and **Coverage**.
- In every year-category combination, **All IDA-eligible countries** has the **highest** value.
- In every year-category combination, **Other regions** has the **lowest** value.
- **Sub-Saharan Africa** is consistently **between** the other two series.
- **Accessibility** is higher than **Coverage** for each group in both 2020 and 2025.
- The **largest bar in the figure** is **All IDA-eligible countries, Accessibility, 2025** at **≈54**.
- The **smallest bar in the figure** is **Other regions, Coverage, 2020** at **≈15**.
- The visual gap between **All IDA-eligible countries** and the two regional series remains substantial in both **Accessibility** and **Coverage**.
- Improvements from 2020 to 2025 appear strongest for **All IDA-eligible countries**, especially in **Accessibility**.

**Source:** World Bank Debt Reporting Heat Map, 2020 and 2025.  

**Note:** IDA = International Development Association.
